headline: Claude's coding capabilities spark developer tool expansion wave
body: Claude Code skills are enabling developers to build specialized tools that extend the AI model's functionality, with emerging use cases ranging from data recovery to IDE integration. For healthcare AI teams, this signals growing flexibility in how Claude can be embedded into clinical workflows and EHR systems through custom code adapters. The velocity around Claude development suggests vendors evaluating AI partners should assess not just base model performance but extensibility architecture. Healthcare organizations experimenting with AI copilots for documentation or clinical decision support should monitor how Claude's coding layer matures, as it directly impacts whether the model can integrate with proprietary legacy systems common in hospital networks.
